newsitem.title: USA: LIPA board to meet December 11 in Uniondale.
newsitem.headline: LIPA board to meet December 11 in Uniondale.

text.p: The Long Island Power Authority said its board of trustees has scheduled its next meeting for 1000 EST/1500 GMT on Wednesday, December 11, at the OMNI in Uniondale, N.Y.
Immediately following the board meeting will be a gathering of its Investment Committee, LIPA added.
The board does not release the agenda for its meetings, LIPA spokesman Seth Hulkower said.
He said the investment committee meeting will be a review of the authority's standard investment policy for funds on hand.
He also described as "incorrect" a report that LIPA was close to putting forward an offer for Long Island Lighting Co, stating the LIPA board member interviewed "was misquoted."
